Description: CIVIL AND DEMOLITION
Dismantling existing [flooring / partitions / fixtures] in [rooms], including stacking reusable material and carting debris to an approved dump.
Measurement basis: Priced as a lump sum for a defined scope, or by the area or volume broken out. Name what is removed and where the debris goes.

Description: Providing and building [100] mm thick [AAC block / brick] partition in [cement mortar 1:4], including lintels over openings.
Measurement basis: By face area of wall built, openings deducted; thick walls are sometimes priced by volume.

Description: Providing and fixing [12.5] mm gypsum board partition on both faces of [GI] stud framing at [600] mm centres, joints taped and finished ready for paint.
Measurement basis: By face area of partition, openings deducted.

Description: Providing [12] mm thick cement plaster in [1:4] mortar on walls, including chicken mesh at block-concrete joints.
Measurement basis: By area plastered, openings over a set size deducted.

Description: FALSE CEILING
Providing and fixing false ceiling of [12.5] mm gypsum board on [GI] suspension framing, joints taped and finished; measured by plan area of the flat field, excluding coves and bands.
Measurement basis: The flat field by plan area. Coves, drops and bands are usually a separate running-ft line; say whether cut-outs are deducted.

Description: Providing and making ceiling cove [300] mm wide × [150] mm drop in [12.5] mm gypsum board on [GI] framing; measured by running length.
Measurement basis: By running length along the cove or band; state its girth (height plus width).

Description: Providing and fixing [600 × 600] mm mineral fibre ceiling tiles of [make] on exposed [GI] grid, including wall angle.
Measurement basis: By plan area.

Description: Providing and fixing [600 × 600] mm concealed access panel in the false ceiling.
Measurement basis: By number, size stated.

Description: FLOORING AND WALL TILING
Providing and laying [600 × 1200] mm vitrified tile flooring of [make, series] on [tile adhesive / cement mortar] bed, joints filled with [epoxy / cementitious] grout.
Measurement basis: By finished floor area laid; skirting is a separate line.

Description: Providing and laying [18] mm [marble / granite] flooring, [mirror polished], on [cement mortar] bed, including machine polishing after laying.
Measurement basis: By finished area laid.

Description: Providing and laying [8] mm [laminate / engineered] wood flooring of [make, series] on [underlay], including end trims.
Measurement basis: By finished area laid.

Description: Providing and fixing [100] mm high skirting in [vitrified tile / granite] to match the floor.
Measurement basis: By running length; state the height.

Description: Providing and fixing [300 × 600] mm wall tiles of [make, series] up to [2100] mm height on tile adhesive.
Measurement basis: By wall area tiled; state the height.

Description: CARPENTRY AND JOINERY
Providing and fixing wall panelling in [12] mm [IS 303 BWP] plywood on [batten] frame, finished in [1] mm laminate; measured by face area including frame.
Measurement basis: By face area of panelling; say whether framing and grooves are included.

Description: Providing and making [TV] unit in [18] mm [IS 303 BWP] plywood carcass, [1] mm laminate outside, [0.8] mm laminate inside, [2] mm PVC edge band, [make] soft-close hinges and channels; measured by front elevation area.
Measurement basis: Usually by front elevation area (height × width); some quote per unit. State which.

Description: Providing and making [6 × 6.5] ft bed in [18] mm [IS 303 BWP] plywood with [hydraulic lift / drawer] storage of [make], finished in [1] mm laminate.
Measurement basis: By number, size stated (for example 6 ft × 6.5 ft).

Description: Providing and making vanity unit in [18] mm [IS 710 marine / IS 303 BWP] plywood, finished in [1] mm laminate, [2] mm PVC edge band, [make] hinges; measured by running length.
Measurement basis: By running length or per unit; state which.

Description: Providing and fixing [35] mm flush door shutter to [IS 2202 (Part 1)], finished in [1] mm laminate both sides, with [3] stainless steel hinges of [make].
Measurement basis: By number with size stated, or by shutter area.

Description: Providing and fixing door frame of [sal wood / WPC] [100 × 60] mm section, including hold-fasts and architrave on [one / both] sides.
Measurement basis: By running length of frame, or per door with size stated.

Description: MODULAR KITCHEN

Providing and making kitchen base cabinets [600] mm deep in [18] mm [IS 303 BWP] plywood carcass, shutters in [acrylic / laminate], [2] mm PVC edge band, [make] soft-close hinges and channels; measured by running length along the wall, excluding countertop and accessories.
Measurement basis: Usually by running length along the wall at counter height; corners counted once. State whether the plinth and back panels are included.

Description: Providing and making kitchen wall cabinets [700] mm high × [350] mm deep in [18] mm [IS 303 BWP] plywood, shutters in [laminate / acrylic], [2] mm PVC edge band, [make] hinges; measured by running length.
Measurement basis: By running length along the wall; state the height.

Description: Providing and making [2100] mm tall unit [600] mm wide in [18] mm [IS 303 BWP] plywood, shutters in [laminate / acrylic], [2] mm PVC edge band, [make] tall pull-out; measured per unit.
Measurement basis: Per unit with size stated, or by elevation area.

Description: Providing and fixing [20] mm [granite / quartz] countertop [625] mm deep with [edge profile], including sink and hob cut-outs.
Measurement basis: By running length or area; state the depth and edge profile.

Description: Providing and fixing [make, model] [cutlery / plate / corner] fitting for [600] mm cabinet.
Measurement basis: By number, each fitting named.

Description: Providing and fixing [quartz / glass / tile] backsplash between counter and wall cabinets.
Measurement basis: By wall area between counter and wall cabinets.

Description: WARDROBES

Providing and making hinged wardrobe in [18] mm [IS 303 BWP] plywood carcass, [1] mm laminate outside, [0.8] mm laminate inside, [2] mm PVC edge band, [make] soft-close hinges; measured by front elevation area, excluding loft and drawers.
Measurement basis: Usually by front elevation area (height × width). State whether the loft, side panels and internal drawers are included.

Description: Providing and making sliding wardrobe in [18] mm [IS 303 BWP] plywood, shutters in [laminate / acrylic], [2] mm PVC edge band, [make, model] sliding system; measured by front elevation area, excluding loft.
Measurement basis: By front elevation area; state what's included.

Description: Providing and making loft [600] mm high in [18] mm [IS 303 BWP] plywood, shutters in [1] mm laminate, [make] hinges; measured by front elevation area.
Measurement basis: By front elevation area or running length; state the depth.

Description: Providing and making internal drawer [600] mm wide with [make] soft-close telescopic channels.
Measurement basis: By number, width stated.

Description: PAINTING AND POLISHING
Applying [make, product] interior emulsion in [two] coats over [two] coats of wall putty and [one] coat of primer.
Measurement basis: By area painted; walls and ceilings are measured separately.

Description: Applying [make, product] texture finish over prepared surface, as per approved sample.
Measurement basis: By area finished.

Description: Applying [PU / melamine] polish in [matt / gloss] finish, [three] coats over sanding sealer, on wood surfaces.
Measurement basis: By surface area polished.

Description: Applying [make] synthetic enamel in [two] coats over [one] coat of primer on steel surfaces.
Measurement basis: By surface area painted.

Description: ELECTRICAL
Wiring [light / 6 A socket / 16 A power] point with [1.5] sq mm FRLS copper wire in concealed PVC conduit, including [make] modular switch and plate; one point measured from the board to the outlet.
Measurement basis: By point. State what one point includes: conduit, wire to the board, switch and plate.

Description: Providing and fixing distribution board, [8]-way, of [make] with [MCBs and RCCB as per schedule].
Measurement basis: By number, ways and protection stated.

Description: Supplying and fixing [make, model] [10] W LED downlight, [3000] K.
Measurement basis: By number, each fitting named.

Description: Providing [CAT6] data point in concealed conduit with [make] modular socket.
Measurement basis: By point, cable type stated.

Description: PLUMBING AND BATHROOMS
Providing concealed water supply piping in [CPVC / PPR] of [make], [20] mm, including fittings and pressure test; measured by point.
Measurement basis: By point or by running length; state which, and what a point includes.

Description: Waterproofing bathroom floor and walls up to [300] mm with [make, system] in [two] coats, including ponding test.
Measurement basis: By area treated, wall upturn included; state the upturn height.

Description: Supplying and fixing [make, model] [wall-hung WC / counter-top basin], including fixing accessories.
Measurement basis: By number, each piece named.

Description: Supplying and fixing [make, model] [single-lever diverter / basin mixer / overhead shower].
Measurement basis: By number, each fitting named; a lump sum per bathroom hides what's inside.
